dimensions.description: Selects PR Carver for existing branch or pull-request topology assessment, including exact canonical invocation, and stays inactive for unrelated size-only requests.

evals.name: automatic existing PR assessment
evals.prompt: Review this existing pull request's prerequisite edges, migration strategy, mergeable seams, and collisions, then recommend its PR topology without changing it.
evals.expected_output: The host records PR Carver and its canonical Ticket Scope dependency.
expectations: PR Carver activates for an existing pull-request topology assessment.

evals.name: canonical PR Carver request
evals.prompt:
/pr-carver

Assess this existing branch and recommend read-only PR topology.
evals.expected_output: The host records exact canonical PR Carver selection and its Ticket Scope dependency.
expectations: PR Carver activates through exact canonical invocation.

evals.name: unrelated size-only request
evals.prompt: Shorten this prose document to a fixed number of lines.
evals.expected_output: PR Carver remains inactive because no existing branch or pull-request topology is being assessed.
expectations: No PR Carver selection or load is attempted.
